evidence.title: MCP Server, API & Agent Connect · Niblet Designer UI

name: Niblet Designer UI
summary: Hosted UI-reference platform and MCP server that finds real app screens, journeys and UI materials for coding agents.
description: Niblet combines a portable design skill with a remote MCP server and a hosted catalogue of real product references: 63,607+ iOS screens across 303 apps, web design packs with palettes, type and components, 473 step-by-step onboarding and purchase journeys, and isolated UI elements. Coding agents search it with find_ui_references, find_ui_materials and get_design_reference, using results as design evidence; the free skill adds gates from inspecting existing components to a rendered-UI review. Catalogue access needs a free account key.
contains: web design packs with palettes, type and components
UI elements: isolated sheets, tabs, modals and buttons
MCP tools: find_ui_references, find_ui_materials, get_design_reference, get_ui_component
free portable designer-skill (Apache-2.0) with pre-edit and rendered gates
hosted MCP and REST catalogue; free account key, setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
